vuln_statements.explanation: This function declaration begins the USB descriptor parsing logic for MIDI streaming endpoints. Based on the vulnerability root cause describing insufficient length validation checks in USB descriptor parsing that could lead to out-of-bounds memory access or integer overflow, this function is the entry point for processing potentially untrusted hardware data from malformed descriptors.
